Prevention: Remove dried leaves periodically and keep the plantation clean.
Do not dump infested materials in the manure pit.
Avoid using suckers for planting from affected areas
Nenthran banana variety which is highly susceptible
Monitoring: Look for presence of small pinhead-sized holes on the stem.
When pinholes are first detected, take action.
Other signs of infestation include the following:
Jelly exudation on the stem is the initial symptom of damage.
Due to secondary infection of pathogens, rotting occurs and a foul odour is emitted.
Direct Control: Trap the adult weevils with pseudostem chopped into small pieces.
Infested trees should be uprooted, chopped into pieces and burnt.
